title: Control of Congress is at stake today. And, judge to consider motion in Clancy case
description: Election Day is here, and voters are heading to the polls in an election that may change control of Congress. And, a judge is considering whether to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case.

title: Four types of House races to watch on election night to know how it might go
description: As polls close on Election Day and results start rolling in, these are some of the House races that will help explain how the midterms are unfolding.

title: From 'model minority' to target, anti-Indian hate on the rise
description: A massacre allegedly targeting Hindu Americans was recently thwarted, but researchers say it helps to illustrate a growing and increasingly mainstream hate directed at South Asians in the U.S.

title: How NPR makes race calls in the 2026 election
description: Race calls are a critical part of election night and NPR partners with the Associated Press to make those calls. Here's how we do it.

title: 'Messy,' 'divided' and 'scary': swing voters rate the country ahead of Election Day
description: One last check in with the Swing Shift voters before Election Day. All of them voted for President Trump. Now, they're rating his presidency and deciding who to support when he's not on the ballot.

title: It's Election Day. Control of Congress is on the line, and what else you need to know
description: There are a lot of variables for how things will go today. Results will start to come in at 6 p.m. ET in Kentucky and Indiana, and then it will be off to the races.

title: A new cold war: hackers target fridges across the globe
description: NPR investigated cyberattacks on the digital devices that control industrial refrigerators, revealing the extent to which operational technology is exposed to damage and disruption.

title: Coal no longer king in Navajo Nation presidential election
description: For the first time in decades, there's no pro-coal candidate for Navajo Nation president. Coal has been an important part of the economy, but voter sentiment is changing.

title: Trump offered a closing message to voters by touting his D.C. renovations
description: In Washington, President Trump delivered his last expected public address, pushing a weaving message to the public about why they should support Republicans.

title: AI chatbots are becoming political advisers. Their answers can mislead voters
description: Millions of Americans are turning to AI for election information, but chatbots are getting voting facts wrong and recommending candidates, raising concerns they could influence voters' decisions.
